facts.fact: The NTRA, with ITIDA, CyShield and licensed e-signature companies, launched a biometric verification and electronic signature system for remote telecoms services, running in a pilot phase that licensed mobile operators will make available gradually in their apps.

systems.system: NTRA biometric verification and e-signature system
systems.platform: integration platform connected to the Interior Ministry's Civil Status Sector

EGY.note: The document links a verification platform to the Civil Status Sector, not the civil register to an ID system.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
Nothing stated on an ID number at birth.
Nothing stated on who operates or owns a national ID system.
Nothing stated on public registers keyed on the national ID number.
Only an initial foundation for a future integrated digital identity system is mentioned; no national ID system is described.
